newsitem.title: UK: ON THE MOVE - John Knight to head UBS energy team.
newsitem.headline: ON THE MOVE - John Knight to head UBS energy team.

text.p: John Knight, a Managing Director of Chase Manhattan, joins the Corporate Finance Division of UBS Limited as Managing Director and head of the bank's European Oil, Gas and Mining team. David Blewden and Bob Gray also join the UBS team from Chase Manhattan.
Jean Rubens is appointed head of Esso France oil trading effective Sept 15. tel 331 4710 6136. Marie-Helene Masse to trade fuel and feedstocks for Esso France 331 4710 6549.
Tom James joins Credit Lyonnais Rouse Derivatives as regional manager for Asia, based in Singapore.
